kitasenju-design--realtime-boxelization.exercise_en: Unproject an iPhone depth map into points, snap them to a 5 cm grid, and render them as blocks with GPU instancing. Twist: make the block size change with the music volume.

theo-watson--remnant.description_zh: 参观者伸出双手，把物质聚拢成一颗恒星，推动它走完整个生命周期，直到它爆发为超新星，留下星云、脉冲星和黑洞。
theo-watson--remnant.idea_en: Reach out to gather matter into a star until it explodes into a supernova and leaves a black hole.
theo-watson--remnant.technique_zh: 手部追踪（大概率使用深度相机）检测张开双手的聚拢手势，把粒子吸引到一个点上，该点的质量不断累积，并在恒星生命周期的每个阶段触发相应的粒子特效。
theo-watson--remnant.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe Hands to detect a gathering gesture that pulls projected particles into a star, which explodes into a nebula once it is full. Twist: the number of participants decides the star's color and lifespan, so one person alone can only make a small red dwarf.

takashi-yoshinaga--lidar-room-scan-ar.description_zh: 一个房间扫描原型：用新款 iPad Pro 的 LiDAR 构建房间的彩色网格，再把它叠加回现实中。
takashi-yoshinaga--lidar-room-scan-ar.idea_en: Scan a room with iPad LiDAR and overlay the mesh back onto reality to view it.
takashi-yoshinaga--lidar-room-scan-ar.technique_zh: ARKit 场景重建生成 LiDAR 网格，把摄像头画面投影到网格上以采样顶点颜色，再将彩色网格叠加回房间。
takashi-yoshinaga--lidar-room-scan-ar.exercise_en: Generate a live room mesh with AR Foundation's ARMeshManager and overlay it on the real space with a wireframe material. Twist: color walls, floor and ceiling differently based on the mesh normal direction.

elevenplay-mikiko--space.description_zh: 在保持社交距离的条件下创作：特殊的摄像装置拍摄舞者，影像被拆解并重建为身体本身无法构成的几何世界。
elevenplay-mikiko--space.idea_en: Break down and reassemble dancers' body data to create geometric worlds the body itself cannot form.
elevenplay-mikiko--space.technique_zh: 多机位拍摄和 GPU 图像处理按照规则集拆解每位舞者的身体数据，并将其实时重组为几何视觉效果。
elevenplay-mikiko--space.exercise_en: Get joint points with MediaPipe Pose and copy, mirror and rotate them by rule into kaleidoscope geometry. Twist: several classmates join a remote video call and their skeletons combine into a single figure.

wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.description_zh: 一个以蛇为主角的 Wonderscope 故事，在孩子家中的各处 AR 场景里展开，并通过孩子大声说话来推进剧情。
wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.idea_en: Talk with a little AR snake and move the story forward with your voice.
wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.technique_zh: 带骨骼绑定的动画角色锚定在房间中，场景切换由孩子的口头回答通过语音识别触发。
wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.exercise_en: Have an AR character ask you a question and branch into two different storylines based on your spoken answer. Twist: the character remembers what you answered last time.

google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.description_zh: 一个开源工具包，用于在房间中策划基于位置的音频：把声音放置在空间中，手机播放的配乐会随参观者的走动而变化。
google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.idea_en: Place sounds in space to make an AR soundscape that changes as you walk.
google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.technique_zh: ARCore 锚点把音源存储在房间中的特定位置，播放音量和声像随手机被追踪的位置而变化。
google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation to place several invisible sound sources with 3D audio in a room so you hear different music layers as you walk around. Twist: let visitors record their own sounds and place them in the space.

takashi-yoshinaga--spatial-copy-paste.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 2 上框选真实房间中的一块区域，把它作为网格“复制”下来，再把捕捉到的空间“粘贴”到另一位用户的 ARCore 视图中。
takashi-yoshinaga--spatial-copy-paste.idea_en: Copy a piece of real space on HoloLens and paste it into someone else's phone AR.
takashi-yoshinaga--spatial-copy-paste.technique_zh: 用包围盒选取 HoloLens 2 空间网格的一部分，把裁剪后的带颜色网格通过网络发送出去，ARCore 客户端再把它放置在选定的锚点处。
takashi-yoshinaga--spatial-copy-paste.exercise_en: Scan a corner of a desk with Polycam, export the model, and paste it onto another table in a second phone's AR. Twist: shrink it tenfold when pasting to make a miniature landscape.

daito-manabe--terminal-slam.description_zh: 透过混合现实眼镜，涩谷的广告牌和广告被抹去，替换成与音乐同步的故障风视觉（减弱现实）。
daito-manabe--terminal-slam.idea_en: Put on MR glasses and Shibuya's ads are erased and replaced with music visuals.
daito-manabe--terminal-slam.technique_zh: 减弱现实：分析摄像头画面以检测广告牌区域，对其进行遮罩和图像修补，再替换为与音乐同步的视觉内容，然后重新渲染到头显视野中。
daito-manabe--terminal-slam.exercise_en: Use the phone camera to detect and cover text or logos in the frame (with color segmentation or image tracking), and fill them with rhythm-driven glitch graphics. Twist: replace the covered ads with blank space or sky to experience a city without ads.

universal-everything--super-you.description_zh: 一款 iPhone AR 应用，追踪你的身体，把你实时变成一个流动的数字生命体。
universal-everything--super-you.idea_en: Point your phone at yourself and become a flowing digital being.
universal-everything--super-you.technique_zh: ARKit 身体追踪（或人体分割）每帧提供骨架和轮廓，驱动粒子或丝带系统，在摄像头画面中取代用户的身体。
universal-everything--super-you.exercise_en: Use Lens Studio or ARKit body tracking to replace your whole body with particles or ribbons that flow with your joints. Twist: assign each body part a different material, such as smoke, water or text, to make a digital body that expresses your personality.

kitasenju-design--unity-chan-occlusion.description_zh: 借助 ARKit 深度遮挡，跳舞的 Unity-chan 角色能被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。
kitasenju-design--unity-chan-occlusion.idea_en: A virtual character is correctly hidden behind real people and furniture.
kitasenju-design--unity-chan-occlusion.technique_zh: 在 AR Foundation 的 AROcclusionManager 中使用 ARKit 人体遮挡和 LiDAR 环境深度，通过深度测试把角色隐藏在真实的人和家具后面。
kitasenju-design--unity-chan-occlusion.exercise_en: Turn on AROcclusionManager in AR Foundation so a dancing character is correctly hidden behind people and chairs. Twist: when the character is blocked, it pokes its head out to peek.

acute-art--unreal-city.description_zh: 沿伦敦泰晤士河展开的 AR 公共艺术步道，汇集了 Olafur Eliasson、曹斐、Tomás Saraceno 等艺术家的 36 件作品，与 Dazed 联合策划。
acute-art--unreal-city.idea_en: A trail of AR sculptures along the Thames.
acute-art--unreal-city.technique_zh: 基于 GPS 地理定位的锚点（再辅以局部平面检测进行精调）沿步行路线放置一系列雕塑，应用本身则充当由地图引导的展览。
acute-art--unreal-city.exercise_en: Have each student in the class make one AR work, install them by GPS position along a campus walkway, and link them together with WebAR. Twist: design a final work for the exhibition that can be seen only after walking the whole route.

kitasenju-design--virtual-flowers.description_zh: 生成式花朵在房间的扫描表面上萌芽、绽放。
kitasenju-design--virtual-flowers.idea_en: Generative flowers grow and bloom along the room's surfaces.
kitasenju-design--virtual-flowers.technique_zh: 在扫描得到的网格表面上采样点及其法线，程序化的花朵实例沿法线方向生长，并带有尺寸变化的动画。
kitasenju-design--virtual-flowers.exercise_en: Randomly sample points on an AR mesh or plane and grow flowers along the normals that get bigger over time. Twist: flowers grow only where the phone camera has been aimed for more than three seconds.

zach-lieberman--x069317.description_zh: 滑板手 Christopher Ledwig 用 Weird Type 应用让一串文字跟随滑板在空间中的运动留下轨迹（由 Zach 分享）。
zach-lieberman--x069317.idea_en: Someone else takes an AR text tool and finds a new trick: drawing a skateboard's path with words.
zach-lieberman--x069317.technique_zh: 应用每帧采样手机在世界追踪中的位姿，并沿这条路径发射文字字形，于是移动相机就能在三维空间中书写文字。
zach-lieberman--x069317.exercise_en: Make a small tool that leaves a trail of text in the air as you move your phone, then ask classmates to use it while running, jumping or skateboarding. Twist: make the text content change with speed.

wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.description_zh: 一个 Wonderscope 悬疑故事，发生在一座阴森的宅邸中，并在孩子的房间里徐徐展开。
wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.idea_en: A mysterious manor unfolds a detective story in a child's bedroom.
wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.technique_zh: 在房间尺度上放置场景道具和角色，大概率配合基于观看方向的脚本触发器，把孩子的房间变成一出悬疑剧的舞台。
wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.exercise_en: Build a gaze-triggered AR mystery scene where a clue appears only when you look at a certain corner. Twist: once the clue appears, it moves somewhere else if you look away.

michael-nebeling--xrdirector.description_zh: 一个基于角色分工的协作创作工具：一人担任导演，其他人担任演员或摄影师，大家像拍摄一场戏一样在 AR 中共同操控虚拟角色。
michael-nebeling--xrdirector.idea_en: Split roles like on a film set: director, actors and camera rehearse together in AR.
michael-nebeling--xrdirector.technique_zh: 在多台设备之间同步共享的 AR 场景，并为每台设备分配角色，每个角色都有各自用于移动角色、相机和时间线的控制方式。
michael-nebeling--xrdirector.exercise_en: Work in groups with Reality Composer or a shared AR app: one person acts as director and calls out instructions while two others each control a virtual character with a phone to rehearse a 30-second skit. Twist: at the end, the camera operator screen-records the final cut on their phone.

mark-dawson--lidar-matrix.description_zh: 扫描出的房间被贴满下落的《黑客帝国》绿色代码，把他的家变成一场数字雨。
mark-dawson--lidar-matrix.idea_en: Cover the scanned room with the green code rain from The Matrix.
mark-dawson--lidar-matrix.technique_zh: LiDAR 网格使用世界空间投影着色器进行着色，字符纹理随时间向下滚动，在每个表面上生成《黑客帝国》风格的数字雨。
mark-dawson--lidar-matrix.exercise_en: Write a shader for the AR mesh that scrolls a glyph texture downward along the world-space Y axis. Twist: replace the glyphs with the letters of your name or lines of a poem.

luke-hurd--automaton-effect.description_zh: 一个面部特效，为面部网格重新贴图并打光，把用户变成一个由层层金属部件构成的机械自动人偶。
luke-hurd--automaton-effect.idea_en: Turn your face into a mechanical automaton.
luke-hurd--automaton-effect.technique_zh: 在被追踪的面部网格上应用自定义纹理和法线贴图，并在面部锚点上附加额外的三维部件，进行实时打光。
luke-hurd--automaton-effect.exercise_en: Use face-mesh texturing in Lens Studio to turn yourself into a museum relic or a robot. Twist: the parts on your face spring open when you open your mouth.

luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.description_zh: 一个基于面部追踪的特效，在用户的头部切开一个以假乱真的洞，洞里藏着一个微缩的三维场景。
luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.idea_en: Open a hole in your head with a tiny world hidden inside.
luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.technique_zh: 头部周围一个不可见的遮挡网格只写入深度，使放在里面的三维模型看起来像是位于脸上的一个空腔中。
luke-hurd--hole-in-the-head.exercise_en: Use an occluder material to open a hole in your forehead and put a small spinning planet inside. Twist: the scene inside the hole switches when you blink.
